name: Cameron Rowston
summary: Tall Australian middleweight (15-3, 3-0 UFC) out of City Kickboxing, nicknamed 'Battle Giraffe', with a kickboxing background (30+ bouts) and heavy ground-and-pound. On a seven-fight win streak: TKOs of Andre Petroski (R1) and Cody Brundage (R2), then a 30-27 x3 decision over Robert Bryczek built on takedowns and over 10 minutes of top control.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, feint-heavy kickboxer: body kicks to set range, stiff straight punches to stop forward pressure, and knees in close (the knee that dropped Brundage). Checked left hook dropped Petroski. About 4.8 significant strikes a minute.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Uses takedowns opportunistically to get on top and land elbows/ground-and-pound: 3 takedowns and about 10 minutes of control vs Bryczek; finished Petroski and Brundage with ground strikes. 6 career submission wins on the regional scene.
how_they_fight.Defense: Body shots rattled him early vs Bryczek, and Brundage hurt him in the clinch in R1. Takedown defense is the hole: Torrez Finney took him down 10 of 14 times with about 12 minutes of control on the 2024 Contender Series (decision loss). Only stoppage loss was an R1 KO in 2018.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Builds into fights: finishes 7 in R1, 5 in R2, 1 in R3; 2 decision wins. Has lost R1 on a card (Brundage) and then finished in R2. Kept a heavy top pace for 15 minutes vs Bryczek. Never stopped since 2018.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Composed and game-plan driven; says he brings several plans and switches between them. Responds to being hurt by changing levels and taking top position.

patterns: Kicks and feints at range, straight punches to stop pressure
Takes top position after being hit; ground-and-pound finishes
Finishes in R1 or R2; dangerous after a slow first round
Grows into fights and stays busy late
concerns: Wrestling defense against a strong grappler (Finney loss on DWCS)
Body shots and clinch strikes have rattled him
First fight against a veteran of Magomedov's experience
keys_to_beat: Take him down and keep him there (Finney blueprint)
Work the body and close distance past his reach
Avoid giving him top position in scrambles

news.text: Beat Robert Bryczek by unanimous decision (30-27 x3) at UFC Perth for his seventh straight win.
Faces Abus Magomedov on the UFC 333 prelims; no injury or camp news found.
